name: Century Iron & Steel Industrial Co Ltd
summary: Century Iron and Steel Industrial Co., Ltd., established in 1987 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, specializes in the fabrication and distribution of steel structures. Operating across Taiwan and Myanmar, the company also provides welding services for steel components and is involved in the assembly and global export of wind power turbines. Its robust products are integral to a diverse range of undertakings, including towering skyscrapers, bridges, industrial facilities, public infrastructure projects, and various other construction endeavors.
